calculation_steps: For Z(t)=sum rk exp(i omega_k t), Im Z'(0)=M=sum rk omega_k; dynamic correction D=TM.
S(h)=sum rk sin(omega_k h)/h; R=(4 S(h/2)-S(h))/3 removes O(h²) term.
For |omega h|<1, exact alternating series yields |R−M| <= Omega_max^5 h^4/480.
Each probe |error Z|<=eta_c+Omega_max sigma_probe; two symmetric slopes combine error <=3(eta_c+Omega_max sigma_probe)/h.
With normalized state repeatability ζ, total variation in sector weights <=ζ; L1 weight difference <=2ζ. Mean rate drift <=2 Omega_max ζ+2 gain_repeat.
Observed main time differs from true by <=sigma_main; combine at T_max into rational bound kappa.
Replace phase-002 calibration error budget only, preserving target exposure and limitations.
